_doc: Named subsets of the calibration corpus, defined by UNIT SLUG rather than
by a frozen list of fight tags: a set is 'both sides' slugs are in this
list', evaluated against data/calibration/manifest.json's side1/side2, so
the membership recomputes itself when the corpus grows.
THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for these sets. Three tools read this file and
none of them keeps its own copy:
melee: every fight where BOTH armies are melee. elite_fire_lancer is
deliberately absent (it has a ranged volley); scorpion / onager / archer /
basic_melee: the five vanilla trash/knight-line units. A subset of melee.
The steppe-lancer and battle-elephant fights are melee too, but carry
their own quirks (1-tile reach, trample), so the HP report breaks them out
ranged: every fight where BOTH armies are projectile units (Round 5).
Scorpion/onager are siege (their own late round) and elite_fire_lancer is
a charge melee unit with a volley -- neither belongs here.
